say:3:1820828002:1.text: H-How do you know my name?
say:3:1820828002:1.male: H-How do you know my name?
say:3:1820828002:1.female: H-How do you know my name?

choice_prompt:4:1820828002.text: H-How do you know my name?
choice_prompt:4:1820828002.male: H-How do you know my name?
choice_prompt:4:1820828002.female: H-How do you know my name?

say:5:1820828003:1.text: ... So you know the whole story.
say:5:1820828003:1.male: ... So you know the whole story.
say:5:1820828003:1.female: ... So you know the whole story.

say:6:1820828005:1.text: I couldn't keep her here... She left and wandered around the village all day long... Even after Baba Muriel moved her soul elsewhere, she remained a shadow of her former self!
say:6:1820828005:1.source_cn: 我没能拦住她……她还是离开了这里，整日在夕染村游荡……...
say:6:1820828005:1.male: I couldn't keep her here... She left and wandered around the village all day long... Even after Baba Muriel moved her soul elsewhere, she remained a shadow of her former self!
say:6:1820828005:1.female: I couldn't keep her here... She left and wandered around the village all day long... Even after Baba Muriel moved her soul elsewhere, she remained a shadow of her former self!

say:7:1820828006:1.text: It was all my fault! If only I'd reinforced the barriers... If only I'd visited her earlier, or written her more letters...
say:7:1820828006:1.source_cn: 都是我的错！如果我再多设置几道障碍，或是提早几天去看看...
say:7:1820828006:1.male: It was all my fault! If only I'd reinforced the barriers... If only I'd visited her earlier, or written her more letters...
say:7:1820828006:1.female: It was all my fault! If only I'd reinforced the barriers... If only I'd visited her earlier, or written her more letters...

say:8:1820828007:1.text: My failure condemned her to an eternity of suffering! It was all because of me...
say:8:1820828007:1.source_cn: 是我没能救下她！是我害得她饱受永世的折磨！都是我……是...
say:8:1820828007:1.male: My failure condemned her to an eternity of suffering! It was all because of me...
say:8:1820828007:1.female: My failure condemned her to an eternity of suffering! It was all because of me...

say:12:1820828009:1.text: ... You can't get over the guilt, can you?

say:13:1820828010:1.text: You're right about that, living one. When Hilda decided to lock herself away here, I should've tried to talk her out of it.
say:13:1820828010:1.source_cn: 是啊，生者，你说的没错。希尔达说要把自己关在这的时候，...

say:14:1820828011:1.text: But instead of stopping her, I even helped her... Only after she snapped did I realize I'd made a terrible mistake.
say:14:1820828011:1.source_cn: 可我不仅没有阻止她，还帮着她一起……等她彻底发疯后，我...

say:15:1820828012:1.text: I don't deserve happiness, not after what I did to Hilda. My only way to make amends is to stay here... and go through everything she endured.
say:15:1820828012:1.source_cn: 亲手逼疯好友的我，没有资格再享受生活。唯一的赎罪方式，...

say:17:1820828014:1.text: Ironically, even though my body has rotted away, my soul is still intact. To my disappointment, I'm perfectly sane.
say:17:1820828014:1.source_cn: 但是，多么可笑啊……即便我的身体已经腐朽，我的灵魂却仍...

say:18:1820828015:1.text: Baba Muriel has come by many times, offering to transfer my soul... but I've always turned her down.
say:18:1820828015:1.source_cn: 穆婆婆来劝过我很多次，说要帮我转移灵魂，我都拒绝了……

say:19:1820828016:1.text: So, what exactly are you two doing here? Is this some kind of adventure for you?
say:19:1820828016:1.source_cn: 所以，你们来这里究竟是为了什么？探险吗？

choice_prompt:20:1820828016.text: So, what exactly are you two doing here? Is this some kind of adventure for you?
choice_prompt:20:1820828016.source_cn: 所以，你们来这里究竟是为了什么？探险吗？

say:21:1820828017:1.text: Treatment?! Is Hilda injured? Is it serious?!
say:21:1820828017:1.source_cn: 治疗？！——希尔达受伤了？！她伤得很重吗？！

say:22:1820828018:1.source_cn: ……她伤得不重，只是发生了一些意外。

say:23:1820828019:1.text: But we need her help to protect Twilight Village from Bantus.
say:23:1820828019:1.source_cn: 但为了从班题斯手中保护夕染村，我们还需要她的帮忙。

say:24:1820828020:1.text: Bantus? What are those scum trying to pull this time?!
say:24:1820828020:1.source_cn: 班题斯？那群混账又想对诺珐斯和夕染村做什么？！

say:25:1820828021:1.text: I see... Now I know why Baba Muriel sent you here.
say:25:1820828021:1.source_cn: 原来是这样……难怪穆婆婆会让你们来到这里。

say:26:1820828022:1.text: Here... This is the knife I made for Hilda, and I think it's what Baba Muriel needs. During Hilda's last days of lucidity, she returned it to me and asked me to keep it safe.
say:26:1820828022:1.source_cn: 拿去吧……这应该就是穆婆婆说的东西，是我给希尔达做的小...

say:27:1820828023:1.text: Maybe Baba Muriel thinks it can help jog Hilda's memory... Hilda would never allow anyone to destroy the village.
say:27:1820828023:1.source_cn: 穆婆婆或许是想利用它，试着唤醒一点希尔达的记忆吧……她...

say:28:1820828024:1.text: You should go. I'll stay here... and atone for what I've done.
say:28:1820828024:1.source_cn: 你们走吧。我还要留在这里……偿还我的罪孽。

choice:20:0:1.text: Baba Muriel needs Hilda's token for her treatment.
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 穆婆婆需要希尔达的信物为她治疗
choice:20:0:1.male: Baba Muriel needs Hilda's token for her treatment.
choice:20:0:1.female: Baba Muriel needs Hilda's token for her treatment.

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 我们看了希尔达的日志

choice:4:1:2.text: You never stopped trying to help Hilda, did you?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 你一直想救希尔达的，对吧？
choice:4:1:2.male: You never stopped trying to help Hilda, did you?
choice:4:1:2.female: You never stopped trying to help Hilda, did you?

choice:2:1:2.text: Can you hear me out, Bessie?
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 你好好听我讲话行吗，蓓丝安
choice:2:1:2.male: Can you hear me out, Bessie?
choice:2:1:2.female: Can you hear me out, Bessie?
